name: Glassy Overlay
description: A glassy system overlay: notifications, calls, pairing, volume and voice, plus an idle ambient dashboard with clock, weather and now playing, drawn over every app. Includes a launcher settings page for the ambient idle timeout.

data.label: Ambient screensaver
data.description: Show the ambient dashboard (clock, weather, now playing) when the device is idle. Turn off to keep the overlay surfaces without the screensaver.

data.label: Screensaver intensity
data.description: Brightness while the ambient screensaver is showing, in percent. Lower saves more battery. Used as the default in the on-device settings page; a per-device override there wins.

data.label: Ambient dashboard idle timeout (seconds)
data.description: Idle time before the ambient dashboard appears. Used as the default in the on-device settings page; a per-device override there wins.

data.label: Weather location
data.description: City name or "lat,lon" for the ambient dashboard weather. Blank uses the phone's location. Used as the default in the on-device settings page; a per-device override there wins.

data.label: Weather units
data.description: Units for the ambient dashboard weather. Used as the default in the on-device settings page; a per-device override there wins.
